text: The Messenger of Allah, Muhammad, peace be upon him, believed with certainty and was convinced of what was revealed to him from his Lord, and it was right for him to be certain, and the believers likewise believed and acted upon the great Quran, each of them believing in Allah as a Lord and God characterized by attributes of majesty and perfection, and that Allah has noble angels, and that He revealed books, and sent to His creation messengers—we, the believers, do not believe in some of them and deny others, rather we believe in all of them. And the Messenger and the believers said: We have heard, our Lord, what You revealed, and we have obeyed in all of that, hoping that You will forgive—by Your favor—our sins, for You are the One who nurtured us with what You bestowed upon us, and to You—alone—is our return and our destiny.
